tips.text: Use Leap Strike on a friendly minion or ward to close distance or escape when no enemy is near.
Cast Empower just before Leap Strike so the jump lands with bonus magic damage.
Start Counter Strike when enemies are about to hit you in melee range. Recast it after they attack, and they get stunned.
Keep attacking in longer trades; Relentless Assault speeds up Jax's attacks the longer he keeps hitting.
Use Grandmaster-at-Arms in a fight to gain Armor and Magic Resist, but only if it hits an enemy champion.
Counter Strike dodges basic attacks, so use it against enemies who rely on them. The more attacks you dodge, the harder the stun hits.

combos.name: Ward jump escape
combos.when: When you need to escape a gank or disengage from a losing fight.
combos.text: Place a ward, or use an ally minion or ward, then Leap Strike to it. Jax can leap to friendly units and wards.

combos.name: Leap Strike with Empower
combos.when: When you engage an enemy champion in a trade.
combos.text: Cast Empower first, then Leap Strike so the Empower magic damage lands on the leap, then attack. Empower also resets your attack timer.

combos.name: Counter Strike on engage
combos.when: When an enemy is about to attack you, or you want to dodge their autos before leaping in.
combos.text: Start Counter Strike before they hit you to dodge their attacks, then leap in as the stun is about to go off. Each dodged attack boosts the damage.

tips.text: Use Leap Strike on a friendly ward or minion to close distance or escape, and keep it ready for a gank.
Cast Empower just before Leap Strike so the jump lands with bonus magic damage, then keep attacking.
Keep attacking without pausing so Relentless Assault builds his Attack Speed; stopping to walk around lets the stacks fade.
Activate Counter Strike when enemy champions are about to hit you, then recast or wait for the stun. More dodged attacks means more damage.
Use Grandmaster-at-Arms in fights with several enemies. Hitting more champions gives Jax more resistances, and his attacks then trigger bonus damage faster.
Start fights by jumping in with Leap Strike, then use Counter Strike once you are in melee range so the stun catches them.

combos.name: Ward jump escape
combos.when: When you need to escape or reposition and a friendly ward, minion or champion is nearby.
combos.text: Leap Strike can target friendly units and wards, so you can jump to one to get away or cross terrain. Place a ward first to plan an escape.

combos.name: Dodge then stun
combos.when: When enemy melee champions or jungle monsters are about to attack you.
combos.text: Counter Strike dodges basic attacks. Keep it up for a while to build bonus damage, then recast to stun nearby enemies.

tips.text: Use Counter Strike when Aatrox starts a basic attack; you dodge it, and the stun hits if he stays close.
Step out of the edges of The Darkin Blade; the tip of each swing knocks you up and hurts most.
Leap Strike onto a minion or ward to get out of Infernal Chains before the pull lands.
Trade with Empower and steady basic attacks so Relentless Assault builds; Jax wins long fights.
Use Counter Strike when Briar jumps in with Blood Frenzy; she is forced to attack you, so you dodge her attacks and stun her when it ends.
Hold Counter Strike for Head Rush or her attacks. Dodged attacks make the stun hit harder.
Trade in short bursts and step away. Jax's damage comes from consecutive attacks with Relentless Assault, so keep hitting her once she commits.
Save Leap Strike for after she dashes in, or to reach a ward and get away from Certain Death.
Once Briar is marked on you by Certain Death, use Grandmaster-at-Arms for the extra resistances and fight back instead of running.
Use Counter Strike when Darius commits to Crippling Strike or basic attacks; you dodge the attacks and stun him when it ends.
Trade in short bursts and step away. Darius gets stronger the longer he keeps hitting you, so don't stand and brawl early.
Stay out of Apprehend range when it is ready; being pulled in lets him hit you freely.
Once Apprehend is on cooldown, step in with Leap Strike and Empower for a quick trade.
Don't fight Darius at low health once he has many bleeds on you; Noxian Guillotine can finish you.
Use Grandmaster-at-Arms in a fight for extra resistances. It also makes your extra damage hit more often.
Cast Counter Strike when Fiora commits to a fight with attacks; she can't hurt you with basic attacks while you dodge, and she gets stunned when it ends.
Don't bother using Counter Strike against Riposte; Fiora's parry ignores it and her stab can turn the stun back on you.
Wait for Fiora to spend Riposte before you try to stun her. If it's ready, she blocks the stun and you get stunned instead.
Trade in short bursts and step back. Jax gets strong the longer he keeps attacking, so look for fights where Fiora can't easily break your Relentless Assault.
Hold Leap Strike as a way to close the gap or to escape. Fiora's Lunge is a blink-like dash, so don't spend your leap carelessly.
Use Grandmaster-at-Arms in a fight for the extra resistances and faster bonus damage, especially when Fiora is trying to burst you.
Cast Counter Strike when Gangplank shoots Parrrley or hits you; dodged attacks make the stun hit harder, so time it for when he is trading.
Gangplank can cleanse your stun with Remove Scurvy, so wait for it to be used before you commit to an all-in.
Jump on Gangplank with Leap Strike and keep hitting him; Relentless Assault builds attack speed the longer you attack, so don't trade in short pokes.
Fight away from his Powder Keg. An explosion slows you and hurts, and he can chain several kegs.
Gangplank's ultimate can reach anywhere once he hits level 6, so finish fights fast and avoid staying low on health.
Use Counter Strike when Garen commits to a trade; it dodges his basic attacks, and the stun lands when it ends.
Garen's Decisive Strike empowers his next attack, so back off or dodge it with Counter Strike rather than taking it.
Garen's Judgment is a spin, not a basic attack, so Counter Strike does not dodge it. Step out of range instead.
Trade in short bursts with Empower and Leap Strike, then step away. Garen heals when he goes unhit.
Stay healthy once you hit level 6. Demacian Justice finishes low-health targets quickly.
Use Leap Strike on Jayce the moment he swaps to Cannon stance; his ranged form is weak when you are on top of him.
Cast Counter Strike when Jayce goes for basic attacks in Hammer form. It dodges them, then stuns him for a moment.
Keep hitting him without pause so Relentless Assault builds. Trade in one long fight instead of short pokes, where he is stronger.
Play safe in the early levels and avoid his long-range pokes. Wait until you have Grandmaster-at-Arms to fight him.
Do not stand in a line from Jayce. Shock Blast stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you.
Keep Counter Strike for when K'Sante is about to hit you with basic attacks; dodging them makes the stun hit harder.
Trade in short bursts with Leap Strike and Empower, then step away before K'Sante's Ntofo Strikes lands a second time.
Expect K'Sante to be much squishier once he goes All Out, so fight him then, and use Counter Strike to avoid his attacks.
Do not stand in a straight line from K'Sante near a wall; All Out can throw you over it.
Use Counter Strike when Malphite walks up to attack you; you dodge his basic attacks and the stun lands when it ends.
Thunderclap's empowered attack and its cone are still dodged by Counter Strike, so time your stance for when he swings.
Malphite has no fast way to stop your dash, so use Leap Strike to close in after his Seismic Shard is spent.
Stay out of range when his Unstoppable Force is ready at level 6; being knocked up leaves you open to his full combo.
Keep attacking in long chains with Relentless Assault; Ground Slam cuts your Attack Speed, so trade away from it or wait for it to run out.
Use Grandmaster-at-Arms in a fight for the extra resistances; his damage is mostly magic and physical.
Cast Counter Strike when Mordekaiser walks up to attack you; he wastes his basic attacks and then gets stunned.
Sidestep Death's Grasp; it pulls you toward him, so stay out of his line.
Trade in short bursts and step away once Darkness Rise turns on, because its aura keeps hurting you while you stay close.
Before you fight, expect Realm of Death at level 6. Save Leap Strike to a ward or minion for an escape once you are back.
Hit Obliterate bait: stay near minions so it hits several targets, which makes it weaker than on you alone.
Jump on Rumble with Leap Strike when his Heat is high or he is Overheating, then trade freely while he cannot cast spells.
Use Counter Strike when Rumble is about to attack or fire Flamespitter; every attack you dodge makes the stun hit harder.
Keep Rumble in short trades and keep attacking; Relentless Assault builds with each consecutive hit, so Jax wins the longer fight up close.
Step out of the burning trail from The Equalizer instead of fighting inside it; it keeps you slowed and hurts every moment you stay.
Use Grandmaster-at-Arms in a fight against Rumble; the extra resistances help against his magic damage.
Use Counter Strike when Sion walks in to attack. It dodges his basic attacks and stuns him when it ends.
Stay out of Decimating Smash's line, since a long charge stuns for a long time. Jump away with Leap Strike to a minion or ward if you are caught.
Watch for Roar of the Slayer; it often sets up his big Decimating Smash. Sidestep it.
Trade with Empower and your attacks while Sion's Soul Furnace shield is down; Relentless Assault builds your attack speed as you hit.
Don't trade with Teemo while he is blinding you. Wait out Blinding Dart before you go in for the fight.
Use Counter Strike when Teemo tries to attack you; you dodge his attacks and stun him when it ends.
Leap Strike onto Teemo and follow up with Empower; once you are on him, stay on him because he is weak up close.
Watch for bushes and stealthed mushrooms before you step in or leap. Stepping on a Noxious Trap leaves you slowed and revealed.
Don't leap into a bush where Teemo might be hiding. Guerrilla Warfare makes him invisible there even while moving.
Don't walk up and back out of range of Teemo; Toxic Shot poison keeps ticking on you. Commit to the fight or stay away.
Close the gap with Leap Strike, then fight her up close; Vayne is fragile and has to play cautiously once you are on top of her.
Use Counter Strike when she commits to attacking you. It dodges her basic attacks and stuns her when it ends.
Stay away from walls when Condemn is ready. Being knocked into one stuns you and hurts a lot.
Keep attacking her without breaks. Relentless Assault builds your Attack Speed, and Empower adds extra magic damage to your first hit.
Use Counter Strike when Yone starts auto-attacking you; you dodge those attacks and the stun hits him when it ends.
Leap Strike onto a minion to close the gap, then use Empower on your first hit. Yone has no easy way to stop you from reaching him.
Trade in short bursts and keep hitting him. Jax's damage rises with every consecutive attack through Relentless Assault.
When Yone dashes in with his wind wave, you can still cast Counter Strike. Do it early, before he knocks you up.
At level 6, use Grandmaster-at-Arms in a fight to gain resistances and make your hits stronger.
Use Counter Strike when Graves tries to attack you; you dodge his basic attacks, and his shotgun shots are basic attacks.
Jump on Graves with Leap Strike as he is reloading, then keep hitting him so your Attack Speed builds.
Stay in melee range and keep attacking him. Fight Graves up close and avoid chasing him through his Smoke Screen.
Hit the Empower attack first, then Leap Strike in; Graves cannot reload fast enough to punish a committed Jax.
Use Grandmaster-at-Arms in a fight to gain Armor, since Graves deals mostly physical damage.
Use Counter Strike when Jarvan IV walks in to attack; he hits nothing and you stun him afterward. Stay in it long enough to dodge a few attacks first.
Keep out of the line between Jarvan IV and his Demacian Standard; Dragon Strike pulls him along it and knocks you up.
Hold Leap Strike for when Jarvan IV uses Cataclysm; it can still get you out or onto an ally or ward.
In a long fight, keep attacking without pause so Relentless Assault builds up. Jarvan IV wins by hitting you and leaving, so don't chase him.
Use Grandmaster-at-Arms when you are caught inside his Cataclysm ring; the extra Armor and Magic Resist help you win the cramped fight.
Use Counter Strike when Kayn commits to a fight; he loses his basic attacks, and the stun lands when it ends.
Stay out of Blade's Reach when you can; Kayn needs to damage you first before Umbral Trespass can reach you.
When Kayn flees through a wall with Shadow Step, hit him with Leap Strike or Counter Strike; damage or a stun cuts it short.
Keep attacking in a row once a fight starts, so Relentless Assault builds up your Attack Speed.
Stay near your minions or allies when Kha'Zix is around; Taste Their Fear hits far harder on anyone isolated.
Use Counter Strike when Kha'Zix jumps on you. He dodges his basic attacks, and the stun hits him as it ends.
Fight him when Leap is on cooldown. He has a hard time escaping you then, and you can chase with Leap Strike.
Trade in long fights, not short ones. Relentless Assault makes Jax's attacks faster the longer he keeps hitting.
Use Grandmaster-at-Arms when he dives in; it adds resistances if it hits him and makes your attacks hit harder.
Jump on Kindred with Leap Strike when she is away from her teammates. She is fragile, so a fast jump and quick burst can force her to back off.
Use Counter Strike when Kindred's shots are about to land on you. It dodges basic attacks, so her Mounting Dread pounce can be avoided if you time it well.
Stay out of Wolf's Frenzy when you can, or kill Kindred quickly inside it. Wolf bites you while you are in the area.
Do not chase a low-health Kindred into Lamb's Respite. Nobody can die inside it, so back off and come back when it ends.
Use Counter Strike when Lee Sin dives on you; his basic attacks are dodged and the stun that follows catches him in melee range.
Lee Sin leans on his abilities to fight, so trade in short bursts and keep your basic attacks going to build Relentless Assault.
Lee Sin is weaker against magic damage, so open with Empower on your first attack or Leap Strike.
Leap Strike onto a ward or minion to close distance or escape after Lee Sin slows you.
Cast Grandmaster-at-Arms when you fight him up close for extra defense, and so your attacks trigger its bonus damage sooner.
Activate Counter Strike when Master Yi jumps on you; his basic attacks are dodged, and the stun and damage hit him when it ends.
Use Grandmaster-at-Arms when Master Yi dives in; the armor and magic resist make his physical attacks hurt less.
Stun Master Yi with Counter Strike while Highlander is on; it stops stuns even though he ignores slows.
Hit Master Yi hard when Alpha Strike is on cooldown; he has no easy escape then. Leap Strike keeps you on him.
Use Counter Strike when Naafiri and her packmates all attack you; every attack you dodge makes the stun hit harder.
Save Leap Strike to chase when Naafiri backs off, or to jump onto a ward or ally to get away.
Keep hitting her. Relentless Assault builds your Attack Speed, so stay on her instead of poking in and out.
Use Grandmaster-at-Arms when her packmates join the fight; it hurts everyone nearby and gives you extra resistances if it hits her.
Hold Counter Strike for when Nocturne commits to hitting you; he cannot hit you while you dodge, and you stun him when it ends.
Do not walk up to Nocturne while Shroud of Darkness is ready. It blocks your next ability, such as Leap Strike.
Bait out Shroud of Darkness with a cheap ability first, then use Leap Strike once it is down.
When Nocturne casts Paranoia, stay near your team instead of wandering alone. He can dash onto you from far away.
Use Counter Strike as Nocturne's Paranoia dash lands; his hit is a basic attack's worth of damage you can dodge only if you time it, so start it early.
Wait out Counter Strike's dodge before you hit Shyvana's Emberstrike attacks; if she keeps swinging into the stance, you take less and the stun lands.
Use Counter Strike when Shyvana is about to attack you; her basic attacks are dodged and make the stun hit harder.
Fight in short bursts and keep attacking her. Relentless Assault builds up only while you keep hitting, so don't let her kite you or walk away.
Pop Grandmaster-at-Arms once she dives in or you trade; its armor and magic resist help against her damage.
Leap Strike onto a ward or minion to escape when Shyvana is in Dragon Form and has you slowed by Molten Burst.
Hold Counter Strike for when Skarner commits to hitting you; he cannot hurt you with basic attacks while you dodge, and the stun comes right after.
Skarner's Shattered Earth empowered attacks can be dodged, so Counter Strike is strong when he starts his boulder attacks on you.
Do not stand still against Ixtal's Impact; a stun can stop his charge, and Counter Strike gives you one if he runs into you.
Fight him in short bursts and keep attacking; Relentless Assault builds your Attack Speed, so a long chase on him is hard to win.
Use Leap Strike on a ward or minion to get out of his reach before Impale lands, and stay away from walls when he charges.
Use Counter Strike when Sylas commits to a fight; he dodges his basic attacks and the stun lands when he stays close.
Save Leap Strike to close the gap when Sylas backs off, or to jump to a ward and escape his chains.
Hit Sylas with a few basic attacks in a row; Relentless Assault builds your Attack Speed, so keep chasing and don't stop attacking.
Fight with Grandmaster-at-Arms up when you trade; it makes you much tougher and adds extra magic damage to your attacks.
Walk up to Talon with Counter Strike active when he commits; his basic attacks are dodged and he gets stunned when it ends.
Keep attacking Talon without pause; Relentless Assault makes you much stronger in a longer fight, so do not poke and back off.
Use Leap Strike to close the gap when Talon is slowed or after he uses his dash, then follow with Empower for extra damage.
Save Grandmaster-at-Arms for when Talon dives in; the armor and magic resist help you survive his physical burst.
Fight Talon while Shadow Assault is on cooldown; he has a hard time escaping you then.
Hold Counter Strike for when Viego commits to attacking you. It dodges his basic attacks, then stuns him when it ends.
Keep hitting Viego without pause so Relentless Assault builds your Attack Speed. Break off if he stuns or slows you.
Jump in with Leap Strike, then use Empower on your first attack for extra magic damage.
Use Grandmaster-at-Arms once you are in the fight. It gives you extra Armor and Magic Resist, and your bonus damage lands more often.
Use Counter Strike when Xin Zhao starts attacking you. Each dodged attack makes the stun hit harder.
Expect Audacious Charge to land even through Counter Strike. Don't rely on dodging it.
Don't stand in a straight line from Xin Zhao. Wind Becomes Lightning slows you and marks you, so his charge reaches farther.
Break up his Three Talon Strike combo by stepping out of range or using Leap Strike away. The third hit knocks you up.
